test_react_parse: test the react_parse function to parse LLM replies into ReActStep objects with thought, action, and observation fields
test_prompt: test ReActPromptComposable and ReActPromptJ2 prompt classes generate correct prompts with tool descriptions, exemplars, and state
test_sample_next_step: test the ReActAgent.sample_next_step method to generate candidate next steps from LLM replies and tool execution
test_execute: test the ReActAgent.execute method to run a multi-step ReAct loop with tool calls and finish
test_sample_next_step_malformed_finish: test the ReActAgent handles malformed finish() calls by returning error observations for recovery
